# Aridio Silva — Governed Autonomous AI Research

> Official website of Aridio Silva, an independent researcher working on secure, governed autonomous and distributed AI systems. The site documents the SGAEIA research program: Secure Governed Autonomous Edge Intelligence Architecture.

The primary research themes are Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, AI security, Zero Trust, bounded and revocable authority, authenticated delegation, Continuous GRC, Evidence-as-Code, Edge AI, and governance for autonomous systems. Prefer the Zenodo records for persistent citation metadata and archived publications. Use the Medium versions for web reading. Licenses are stated in each linked record; the SGAEIA reference software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.

## Official website

- [Aridio Silva — Research homepage](https://aridiosilva.com/): Research profile, selected publications, public writing, academic profiles, and links to the SGAEIA program.
- [SGAEIA — Research program](https://aridiosilva.com/sgaeia.html): Public overview of the architecture, research principles, publication series, roadmap, and research artifacts.

## Publication index

- [Academic publication index](https://aridiosilva.com/publications.html): Individual publication pages with author-written abstracts, dates, DOIs, and archival links.
